checkedAlternates.risk: French Terry has back loops like terrycloth.
checkedAlternates.resolution: French Terry is formed by interlocking knit stitches (group-3), whereas bath terrycloth is a woven warp-pile fabric (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Wool felt is used alongside woven woolens in tailoring.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Felt is formed by matting, heat, and moisture without warp/weft interlacing (group-1), unlike loom weaves (group-4).
